name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA), 2005
change: Provides a legal guarantee of 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households for unskilled manual work.
impact: Acts as a safety net for rural poor and reduces distress migration, though issues like delayed payments and inefficiency exist.

name: Public Distribution System (PDS) Reform, 2013
change: Ensures subsidized distribution of essential food grains like rice and wheat to low-income households through ration shops.
impact: Reduces hunger and ensures food security, but faces challenges like leakage and targeting inefficiencies.

name: National Food Security Act, 2013
change: Provides legal entitlement to subsidized food grains to approximately two-thirds of the population.
impact: Strengthens food security and reduces poverty, though it puts pressure on fiscal resources.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan, 2019
change: A voluntary pension scheme for unorganized sector workers providing a fixed monthly pension after retirement.
impact: Provides social security for informal workers, though awareness and enrollment remain limited. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}

name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP), 1995
change: Provides financial assistance to elderly, widows, and disabled individuals living below the poverty line.
impact: Supports vulnerable populations with basic income security, though benefit amounts are relatively low.

name: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) Policy, 2013
change: Transfers subsidies and welfare benefits directly into beneficiaries’ bank accounts using Aadhaar-linked systems.
impact: Reduces corruption and leakage in welfare delivery, but exclusion errors can occur due to technical issues. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao Scheme, 2015
change: Focuses on improving child sex ratio and promoting education and empowerment of girls.
impact: Raises awareness about gender equality and improves female education, though measurable impact varies across regions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana, 2016
change: Provides free LPG connections to women from below poverty line households to replace traditional cooking fuels.
impact: Improves health outcomes and reduces indoor pollution, though refill affordability remains a concern.

name: Atal Pension Yojana, 2015
change: Encourages workers in the unorganized sector to save for retirement with guaranteed pension benefits.
impact: Promotes long-term financial security, but participation depends on financial awareness.

name: One Nation One Ration Card Scheme, 2020
change: Allows beneficiaries to access subsidized food grains from any ration shop across India using digital authentication.
impact: Improves portability for migrant workers and ensures continuous access to food support. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
